# Samsara Ventures

> Samsara Ventures is a New York-based M&A advisory firm. It provides operational due diligence, divestiture and carve-out, post-merger integration, private equity value creation, and operating model transformation support to private equity firms and corporations across North America.

## Services
- Due diligence: operational due diligence (ODD), IT and technology diligence, buy-side and sell-side support, risk and value creation assessment
- Divestitures and carve-outs: separation strategy and planning, transition services (TSAs), standalone readiness
- Mergers and integration: integration planning and management, synergy capture, organization and change
- Private equity portfolio support: value creation planning, 100-day plans, interim program leadership, exit readiness
- Operating model and cost transformation: operating model design, cost optimization, program management
- Growth and go-to-market strategy: go-to-market strategy, product and AI commercialization, commercial planning

## Clients
- Private equity firms and their portfolio companies
- Corporations (including Fortune 500 companies) buying, selling or reshaping businesses

## Industries
Healthcare and life sciences; financial services; industrials and manufacturing; aerospace and defense; business services; technology, media and telecom; consumer and retail; energy and utilities

## About
Senior-led firm built by advisors with more than a decade of transaction and transformation experience at PwC, EY-Parthenon and Deloitte.
